notes: The page confirms free pickup at an Apoteket pharmacy and at an apoteksombud, and free standard delivery over 300 kr, but shows the per-option fees only at checkout. An apoteksombud is an agent inside another shop (often a grocery store), so it is modelled as a free pickup point, while pickup at an Apoteket pharmacy is store pickup. The 39 kr standard fee and the 69 kr home fee (with no threshold) are conservative guesses until a checkout probe confirms them.
